description: What changed on a project since you last looked: new threads, new replies grouped by thread, what was resolved or deferred, and what was assigned to you or mentioned you. Call it at the start of a session. Without `since` it reads from your bookmark and moves it forward; with `since` it reads that window and leaves the bookmark alone.

projectId.description: Optional if a project is bound.

since.description: Optional. A date or time ("2026-09-01", an ISO time) to read from instead of your bookmark.

name: whats_new
title: What's new
